verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is a web-crawling and extraction library and server, not an agent or host application, so consuming tools from external MCP servers falls outside its product role. The MCP evidence (gh-27, probe-3, comm-5/6) shows Crawl4AI acting as an MCP server for tools like Claude Code and Cursor. That is the server role and cannot be credited toward this client-side story. Nothing in the pack shows Crawl4AI connecting to other MCP servers.
